instruction: Install ReOL and its bundled Skills from this source, then guide me through any required sign-in and consent and check read-only access.

authentication.requiredUserAction: Complete sign-in and consent in the host or ReOL page. Never paste credentials into chat.
authentication.completionEvidence: A successful authorized read with the selected identity using current ReOL operation docs.

failures.clientMissingCommands: Use a supported host Plugins interface or ask for help before changing the client.
failures.sourceUnavailable: Check the source address and connection. Keep the current installed version; do not switch to an unrelated source.
failures.skillsMissing: Check installation and enabled state, then open a fresh conversation. If the package is damaged, remove it and install again from the same source.
failures.authorizationPending: Stop authenticated actions and ask the user through their chosen contact route. Do not restart sign-in repeatedly.
failures.accessDenied: Check the selected identity and target app in current ReOL docs. Do not switch accounts or expand permissions automatically.
failures.unknownWrite: Read the operation-specific receipt/status before retrying. Keep the same intent and supported request key.
